<title level="2" right="Creature 11">[Crystalline Sentinel](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2565)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="N" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Elemental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=57" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #191: The Destiny War](/Sources.aspx?ID=199) pg. 42

**Perception** +20; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=40) (imprecise) 60 feet

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Terran](/Languages.aspx?ID=22)

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +22, [Geology Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +19, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +22, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +22

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +7

**Dex** +3

**Con** +5

**Int** +0

**Wis** +5

**Cha** +0
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 30 [all-around vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=1)

**Fort** +22 

**Ref** +18 

**Will** +22 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 195

</row>

**Immunities**
bleed, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145)

**Resistances**
[cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27) 10, [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56) 10, [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72) 10

**Weaknesses**
bludgeoning 10, [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147) 10

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet, burrow 20 feet; earth glide

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaw +24 ([deadly d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=174)),
**Damage** 2d12+13 piercing plus crystal corruption

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +24 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)),
**Damage** 2d8+13 slashing plus crystal corruption

**Claw Frenzy** <actions string="Two Actions" />  The xorn makes three claw Strikes; no more than two can be against the same target. These attacks count toward the xorn's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks have been made.

**Crystal Corruption**  ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Curse](/Traits.aspx?ID=38), [Incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=93), [Transmutation](/Traits.aspx?ID=157)) Creatures afflicted by this curse slowly turn to solid crystal. This affliction's [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34), [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=35), and [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28) conditions can't be removed until the affliction itself is removed. Creatures with both the [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55) and [elemental](/Traits.aspx?ID=57) traits instead become carriers and suffer no ill effects aside from gaining the weakness to [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147). **Saving Throw** DC 30 Fortitude; **Stage 1** sickened  1 (1 hour); **Stage 2** weakness 5 to sonic and sickened 1 (1 day); **Stage 3** weakness 5 to sonic and slowed 1 (1 day); **Stage 4** weakness 10 to sonic and paralyzed (1 day); **Stage 5** weakness 10 to sonic, and the creature is permanently [petrified](/Conditions.aspx?ID=30).

**Crystal Splinter**   On a critical hit with a claw Strike, the crystalline sentinel inflicts 2d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29).

**Earth Glide**   The xorn can [Burrow](/Actions.aspx?ID=93) through any earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, the xorn moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

</column>
